text.answer: Rell is a tank support who engages with a shielded leap and nearby pulls. Her abilities deal magic damage, while health strengthens her Crash Down shield and resistances strengthen her passive attack damage. Counterplay: Spread out and keep distance from her engage.

text.counterplay: Disengage from prolonged contact to let the resistance debuff expire.
